department: Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: January 1, 2027; fee-waiver and language-waiver requests are due December 1.
deadline.quote: The deadline for receipt of graduate applications is January 1st.

gre_general.value: The GRE requirement has been eliminated and is not considered.
gre_general.quote: The GRE exam requirement has been eliminated from the graduate application and will not be considered in our evaluation process.

fee_waiver.value: A limited number of departmental waivers, only for applicants who first correspond with the faculty advisor of a recruiting lab; request by December 1.
fee_waiver.quote: The department awards a limited number of application fee waivers to highly qualified applicants

supervisor.value: Applicants are told to contact the professor they want to work with before applying.
supervisor.quote: When applying to our program, you should also contact the professor(s) with whom you would like to work. It is very important to connect with a potential faculty mentor prior to applying for best chance at admission.

funding.value: The PhD is generally five years and includes full funding.
funding.quote: This is generally a five-year program and includes full funding.

entry_route.value: Direct entry from undergraduate study is accepted, as is entry with an M.S.
entry_route.quote: EES accepts Ph.D. applicants directly from undergraduate study as well as applicants who have already completed a M.S. degree in the field.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

notes: The department page still names the 2025 recruiting faculty. Environmental sciences are covered by the same PhD.
